direct_evidence_confirmed_chunks_within_.note: These are the two 500-block sub-chunks actually attempted (16779844-16780843) after the chunker halved 2000 -> 1000 -> 500 on repeated range-too-large-style responses before confirming a hard per-endpoint refusal. Not extended chunk-by-chunk across the full 16779844-16843829 range because the follow-up diagnostic calls below establish the refusal is endpoint-side and block-age-based, not content- or chunk-size-dependent -- iterating the remaining ~63,000 blocks in 500-block windows would reproduce the identical four errors ~127 more times for no new information.

diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.call: eth_getLogs fromBlock=toBlock='latest' (tag, not a number), Curve 3pool, TokenExchange topic0
diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.result: SUCCESS via https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (0 logs, as expected for a single block)

diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.call: eth_getLogs fromBlock=hex(head-5) toBlock=hex(head) (numeric, near head), same filter
eth_getLogs fromBlock=0x1888B00 toBlock=0x1888B32 (numeric, ~9.1M blocks before head, far short of the actual 2023-03 target but still a fixed historical number), same filter
diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.result: FAILED on all 4 endpoints with the same errors as the in-range attempts below

diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.call: eth_getBlockByNumber(16780000, false) -- historical BLOCK HEADER (not logs/state)
diagnostic_calls_establishing_root_cause.result: SUCCESS via https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (timestamp=1678235519, number=16780000) -- headers are NOT gated the way logs/state are

conclusion: publicnode's free tier serves eth_getLogs only for the 'latest' tag or a small window of numeric blocks near the current head; ANY numeric block specification reaching back toward March 2023 (head - ~9.1M blocks) is rejected with the identical 'Archive requests require a personal token' error seen in the D10 archival eth_call probe (d10_probe.json). This is consistent, not chunk-size- or content-dependent. The other three endpoints fail eth_getLogs unconditionally in this environment (llamarpc: persistent TLS/525 handshake failure; cloudflare-eth.com: -32603 'Internal error' even for a trivial live 1-block query, i.e. it appears not to support eth_getLogs on its public gateway at all; rpc.ankr.com/eth: -32000 'Unauthorized', requires an account/API key even for basic calls -- its keyless/anonymous tier no longer covers eth_getLogs). eth_getBlockByNumber for the SAME historical blocks succeeds via publicnode (headers are cheap and not gated), which is why Task 4 (hourly block anchors) is NOT gated by this same restriction -- see hourly_block_anchors.csv.
